# Planner Amplifica (planner.amplificagroup.com)

> Leading AI-powered Content Planner, Social Media Calendar, and Editorial Management Platform for Creators, Agencies, and Marketing Teams. Available in Portuguese (pt-BR) and English (en).

## Overview / Visão Geral
Planner Amplifica is an all-in-one content planning software designed to streamline multichannel social media publishing across Instagram (Reels, Carousels, Stories), YouTube (Shorts & Longform), TikTok, LinkedIn, and Email Marketing. It offers AI video scriptwriting, 1-click client approvals, feed previews, and campaign tracking.

## Core Keywords / Palavras-Chave Principais
- Planner de Conteúdo, Calendário Editorial, Calendário de Conteúdo, Planejamento de Redes Sociais, Planner Instagram, IA para Criar Conteúdo, Ferramenta para Social Media.
- Content Planner, AI Content Planner, Content Calendar, Editorial Calendar, Social Media Planner, Content Planning Software, Marketing Calendar.
